title: Trickster Golemancy
description: Adds golems to the Trickster mod!
body:
Create and control golems with the Trickster mod!

# Making a Golem

Put a Spell Core in your off-hand then use this spell.
![Golem Core creation](https://i.postimg.cc/9fS3J8bd/2026-07-03-07-07-25.png)

Then use the Golem Core on a Copper Block.

# Moving Golems

Golems can be moved using the spell inscribed on the Golem Core.

The following pathfinds the golem to a given vector position.

![Golem movement](https://i.postimg.cc/j5dW4j89/2026-07-03-07-16-04.png)

The following will return whether the golem is currently moving.

![Golem movement querying](https://i.postimg.cc/DfGWQR6p/2026-07-03-07-19-34.png)

The following will stop the golem.

![Golem movement CEASE](https://i.postimg.cc/KvFYPjRf/2026-07-03-07-21-02.png)
